name: Oom Vetkoek
address: 51 Lang St, Bergsig, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Authentic vetkoek and traditional South African treats in a cosy Great Brak River cafe.
description_long:
Oom Vetkoek brings proper South African nostalgia to Great Brak River with their signature vetkoek—golden, pillowy, and filled just the way ouma used to make them. Whether you go savoury with mince or sweet with jam and syrup, each vetkoek is made fresh and served with a smile in their welcoming cafe on Lang Street.

Beyond the vetkoek, you'll find koeksisters, rusks, and other traditional bakes that pair perfectly with a cup of coffee. The atmosphere is relaxed and homely, making it an ideal stop for breakfast or a midday treat. They also stock local gifts and produce, so you can take a taste of the Garden Route home with you.

Located in the quiet Bergsig area of Great Brak River, Oom Vetkoek is a short drive from Mossel Bay and a lovely detour if you're exploring the coast. It's the kind of place where locals pop in regularly, and visitors leave with full bellies and happy memories.
